title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Implementation Opinions of the People's Courts on Implementing the Opinions of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on Implementing the Legal Popularization Responsibility System of State Organs (Who Enforces the Law Shall Popularize the Law)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Implementing Opinions of the People's Courts on Implementing the Opinions of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on Implementing the Responsibility System for Legal Popularization by State Organs under the Principle of "Who Enforces the Law, Who Popularizes the Law"

Fa Fa [2017] No. 32

All local people's courts at various levels, all military courts, and all courts of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

The Implementing Opinions of the People's Courts on Implementing the Opinions of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on Implementing the Responsibility System for Legal Popularization by State Organs under the Principle of "Who Enforces the Law, Who Popularizes the Law" are hereby issued to you for your conscientious implementation in light of actual circumstances.

December 15, 2017

Implementing Opinions of the People's Courts on Implementing the Opinions of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on Implementing the Responsibility System for Legal Popularization by State Organs under the Principle of "Who Enforces the Law, Who Popularizes the Law"

To deeply study the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, fully implement the Opinions of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on Implementing the Responsibility System for Legal Popularization by State Organs under the Principle of "Who Enforces the Law, Who Popularizes the Law" (Zhong Ban Fa [2017] No. 31, hereinafter referred to as the "Opinions"), implement the responsibility system for legal popularization by state organs under the principle of "who enforces the law, who popularizes the law," further establish and improve the legal education and publicity mechanism of the people's courts, and deepen the innovative development of legal popularization work in the people's courts, these implementing opinions are formulated.

I. Deeply Comprehend the Spirit of the Opinions and Continuously Enhance the Understanding of the Significance of Implementing the Responsibility System for Legal Popularization under the New Situation

The report of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China put forward new requirements for further improving legal education and publicity work, emphasizing the need to intensify the nationwide popularization of law, build a socialist rule-of-law culture, and establish the legal concepts that the Constitution and laws are supreme and all are equal before the law. Implementing the responsibility system for legal popularization by state organs under the principle of "who enforces the law, who popularizes the law" is an important measure to thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and to implement the decisions and deployments of the CPC Central Committee on comprehensively governing the country by law. People's courts at all levels shall combine the implementation of the responsibility system for legal popularization with the study and implementation of the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, effectively enhance the understanding of the importance of implementing the responsibility system for legal popularization under the principle of "who enforces the law, who popularizes the law," fully implement the primary responsibility for legal popularization, improve work systems, strengthen supervision and inspection, emphasize division of labor and coordination, continuously promote the in-depth development of legal popularization work in people's courts, and form a work pattern of "territorial management, graded responsibility, and overall linkage."

II. Closely Align with the Requirements of the Opinions and Continuously Innovate the Methods and Means of Legal Popularization, Education, and Publicity by People's Courts

(1) Clarify the Content of Legal Popularization Work by People's Courts. It is necessary to deeply study and publicize Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully comprehend and resolutely implement the important deployments of the CPC Central Committee on comprehensively governing the country by law, so that cadres and police officers of the people's courts become sincere believers, conscious practitioners, and firm defenders of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era; it is necessary to deeply study and publicize the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics with the Constitution as the core, forming a good atmosphere of respecting the Constitution, abiding by the Constitution, and safeguarding the authority of the Constitution; it is necessary to deeply study and publicize the Party Constitution and intra-Party regulations, enhance the awareness of the Party Constitution, Party regulations, and Party discipline among Party members and cadres of the people's courts, educate and guide Party members and cadres of the people's courts to respect the Party Constitution, take the Party Constitution as the fundamental guideline, and resolutely safeguard the authority of the Party Constitution.

(2) Establish a Mechanism for Overall Linkage in Legal Popularization. The legal popularization work of the people's courts shall be closely integrated with the work of judicial openness, fully utilizing the four platforms of trial process openness, trial activity openness, judgment document openness, and enforcement information openness to promote the in-depth development of legal popularization work. Relying on informatization construction, with the help of the "People's Courts 'Online Communication' Exchange Platform," a communication and coordination system with upper and lower linkage and effective feedback among the four-level courts shall be realized.

(3) Implement a System of Responsibility Lists for Legal Popularization. People's courts at all levels shall clarify the key legal regulations and responsible departments for publicity, designate specific persons to be responsible, formulate responsibility lists for legal popularization (template attached), draft annual work plans for legal popularization, and timely report the annual plans to the superior court for filing. People's courts at all levels shall conscientiously summarize good experiences and practices in carrying out legal popularization education and implement an annual reporting system for legal popularization work. Before the end of December each year, the work situation of implementing the responsibility for legal popularization in the current year shall be reported to the superior court.

(4) Improve the System for Leading Cadres of People's Courts to Study and Use the Law. People's courts at all levels shall further improve the system for the theoretical study center group of the Party organization to study the law, continuously enhance the awareness and ability of leading cadres of people's courts at all levels to study, abide by, and use the law, and make decisions according to law. In principle, the theoretical study center group of each level's Party organization shall study the law no less than twice a year, which may be conducted through a combination of determining topics, key speeches, and collective discussions.

(5) Improve the Daily Legal Study System for Cadres and Police Officers of People's Courts. People's courts at all levels shall improve the daily legal study system, promote the regularization of legal study for court cadres and police officers. Strictly implement the requirements of the CPC Central Committee's "Regulations on Cadre Education and Training Work," make full use of platforms such as the National Judges College and its local branches, strengthen the assessment of cadres and police officers' study of the Constitution, laws, and intra-Party regulations, and incorporate assessment results as important content for evaluating annual work performance.

(6) Establish a Mechanism for News Planning and Agenda Setting in Legal Popularization Work. People's courts at all levels shall, based on the characteristics of media publicity and the angle of information collection, carry out legal popularization work to the public around social hot spots and difficult issues. Strengthen agenda setting, organically combine court legal popularization work with the interests of the media and the public, and plan news publicity highlights through forms such as media planning meetings and regular meetings of news contacts. While popularizing legal knowledge, more emphasis shall be placed on promoting the spirit of the rule of law, cultivating rule-of-law concepts, and establishing rule-of-law awareness. Vigorously publicize rule-of-law concepts such as the supremacy of the Constitution and laws, equality of all before the law, no punishment without law, evidentiary adjudication, acquittal for doubt, and procedural justice, give full play to the value-leading and spiritual nurturing role of rule-of-law concepts, and ensure that legal popularization work achieves good social repercussions.

(7) Utilize the Drafting and Interpretation of Judicial Interpretations and Normative Documents to Carry Out Legal Popularization Work. During the process of drafting judicial interpretations or formulating normative documents, the Supreme People's Court shall, for matters of high social concern and wide-ranging interests, extensively solicit public opinions, mobilize broad participation from all sectors of society, and enhance the public's understanding and recognition of the forthcoming judicial interpretations and normative documents. After the issuance of judicial interpretations and normative documents, various platforms and easy-to-understand language shall be used to explain and clarify to the public, turning the process of drafting and formulating judicial interpretations and normative documents into a legal popularization process. People's courts at all levels shall, in response to judicial hot issues of public concern, actively carry out authoritative interpretations, organize publicity and explanations, and achieve the effect of popularizing legal knowledge and guiding values.

(8) Utilize Press Conferences to Increase the Intensity of Legal Popularization Work. People's courts at all levels shall use the press conference system to further increase the intensity of releasing information on judicial policies, progress in judicial reform, and trial situations of relevant cases. Based on the dissemination characteristics of various media, categorize and emphasize differently, and further expand the dissemination power and influence of press releases on legal popularization work through full-media means such as text, pictures, videos, and audio.

(9) Vigorously Carry Out Case-Based Legal Interpretation Work. In litigation activities, people's courts at all levels shall, based on the circumstances of the case and under the premise of maintaining trial secrets and abiding by trial discipline, conduct targeted legal interpretation at various stages of case handling, promptly clarify doubts, and make the trial of cases, mediation of disputes, and legal services a process of popularizing the law to the people. Establish a system for judges to interpret the law through cases, making the lawful trial of hot cases a public lesson for nationwide legal popularization. Enhance the reasoning of judgment documents, and timely upload judgment documents to the China Judgments Online in accordance with regulations. Conduct case-based legal interpretation through forms such as circuit trials, live broadcasts of trials, expert interpretations, and publicity groups. Strengthen the collection, collation, research, and issuance of typical cases, and hold news briefings on typical cases as appropriate. Further increase cooperation with television stations and other news media, focusing on increasing the proportion of judicial cases in legal popularization programs, conduct follow-up filming of typical cases, and popularize the law in the form of storytelling.

(10) Establish a Resource Database for Legal Education and Publicity. The Supreme People's Court shall establish a resource database of cases for legal education and publicity, giving full play to the guiding, regulating, preventive, and educational functions of typical cases. Each High People's Court shall submit to the Supreme People's Court no less than five cases with typical legal popularization significance or activities of legal education and publicity within its jurisdiction each quarter (template attached).

(11) Continuously Innovate the Forms of Public Open Day Activities. People's courts at all levels shall make full use of time nodes such as National Constitution Day, anniversaries of the promulgation and implementation of laws, legal publicity months, weeks, and days, actively organize and carry out distinctive, diverse, vivid, and effective public open day activities. Strengthen cooperation with relevant units to film documentaries or TV series reflecting the trial or enforcement of people's courts. People's courts at all levels may use forms such as filming micro-movies or public service advertisements to increase the intensity of legal popularization.

(12) Establish and Make Good Use of Legal Education and Publicity Bases of People's Courts. People's courts at all levels shall continuously explore innovations in legal popularization concepts, content, genres, and forms, enhancing pertinence and effectiveness. The Supreme People's Court will research and determine legal education and publicity bases of people's courts, cultivate units with significant results in legal popularization work as demonstration sites, give full play to the exemplary and driving role of advanced models, and promote the in-depth development of the legal popularization responsibility system.

III. Strengthen Organizational Leadership and Continuously Promote the Implementation of the Legal Popularization Responsibility System of People's Courts

(1) Clarify Legal Popularization Responsibilities. People's courts at all levels shall establish a legal popularization responsibility system, regard legal popularization work as fundamental work for the construction of the rule of law, grasp it tightly and earnestly, integrate it into various work of the people's courts, include it in the overall work layout, and deploy, inspect, and implement it together with trial and enforcement work. People's courts at all levels shall firmly establish the concept of full participation and everyone's responsibility, establish and improve the leadership and working bodies for legal popularization, and clarify specific responsible departments and responsible personnel.

(2) Establish Assessment Standards. People's courts at all levels shall incorporate legal popularization work into the assessment of organ work objectives and the performance assessment of leading cadres, and into the content of rule-of-law construction and the creation of spiritual civilization. The Supreme People's Court will formulate assessment standards with reference to the national assessment indicator system and methods for legal education and publicity, commend and reward localities, departments, and individuals with well-implemented responsibilities and significant results in legal popularization work, and notify localities, departments, and individuals with poorly implemented responsibilities and unfulfilled legal popularization objectives. The strength of rule-of-law concepts, the quality of rule-of-law literacy, and the ability to act according to law shall be used as important criteria for inspecting and selecting cadres.

(3) Strengthen Work Guidance. Superior courts shall strengthen guidance and inspection of courts within their jurisdiction. Based on the actual work of the people's courts in the area under their jurisdiction, analyze the legal needs of different regions and different targets, treat them differently, provide classified guidance, and continuously enhance the pertinence of legal education and publicity. Adhere to a problem-oriented approach, go deep into the grassroots and the masses for investigation and research, strengthen supervision and guidance, actively solve problems, and strive to advance work.

(4) Strengthen Work Guarantees. People's courts at all levels shall promptly study major issues in legal popularization work, strengthen guarantees in personnel, funding, and materials, and create conditions for legal popularization work.
